novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: it proposes that “the steering vector estimated from the teacher’s activations during neutral generation, when added to the student, induces the trait,” thereby identifying the covert subliminal payload with a low-dimensional activation-space carrier. Searches for “subliminal learning activation steering neutral data,” “persona vectors finetuning activation direction,” and “activation patching behavioral trait transfer without training” identify Persona Vectors (2025) as the closest work because it relates trait directions to behavioral changes from finetuning, alongside Cloud et al.’s Subliminal Learning (2025) and standard representation-engineering work, but none of the supplied or located work establishes steering vectors extracted specifically from covert neutral generations as substitutes for subliminal finetuning. The step is a non-trivial but natural integration of those established ideas rather than a wholly new intervention paradigm: deriving and causally applying the direction from the subliminal channel changes the operationalization and source of the vector, while activation steering itself remains standard.
